Acceptance enumeration for STORY-2912, origin STORY-b6b1278890774ef993d2ebc327862470-805:
1. accdae61: With no-new-failures and a passed smoke test, allow C when every failing CI test at C also fails at currently promoted P; obtain per-test failing sets from CI, rerunning C's failing tests at P if P has no run — unverified: equal_failing_sets_allow and promoted_without_a_run_reruns_the_failing_tests cover fake evidence, but the real rerun lacks required binaries and changes CI's configuration; the evidence reader omits some test failures.
2. acd07159: Any test failing at C but not P refuses promotion, naming those tests — unverified: a_new_failure_refuses_naming_it and a_failure_in_a_shard_green_at_p_refuses cover nextest fixtures, but gate/contract lane identity and omitted doctests can hide new failures.
3. ac7366e2: Unreadable or missing CI evidence for C refuses with a named reason — unverified: missing_candidate_evidence_refuses and incomplete_candidate_ci_refuses cover several refusal cases, but partial report inventories can still allow promotion.
4. ac77195c: Record candidate, promoted SHA, failing sets and verdict in the promotion audit and show them in dev status — unverified: decision_records_round_trip and story2912_allowed_comparison_is_recorded_with_the_promotion cover persistence and summary output, but status omits the shared failing-test names.
5. Tests: equal failing sets allowed; a new failure refused and named; missing evidence refused — verified by the added equal_failing_sets_allow, a_new_failure_refuses_naming_it and missing_candidate_evidence_refuses test definitions, inspected as source; exact-head behavioral execution is not established by FAST compilation. All five supplied previously-untraced entries now have corresponding tests in the diff; the findings identify missing behavioral coverage, rather than reporting those entries as wholly untested.
